user.title: Create a multi-mode thermostat
user.description: Each device adds a mode: a heater adds Heat, a cooler adds Cool, a fan adds Fan only and a dryer adds Dry. A heater plus a cooler can also offer Heat/cool. Devices can be switches, input booleans, fans, lights, groups or dehumidifiers.

data_description.target_sensor: The current temperature the thermostat acts on.
data_description.fan: Runs in Fan only mode. It can also run alongside the heater or cooler: see the next step.
data_description.target_humidity_sensor: Optional. Only displayed as the current humidity; it doesn't affect control.

data_description.enable_heat_cool: Adds a mode that keeps the temperature within a range: heating below it, cooling above it.
data_description.fan_behavior: In Fan only mode, run all the time, or work around the target like a cooler or a heater.
data_description.dryer_behavior: In Dry mode, run all the time, or work around the target like a cooler or a heater.
data_description.reverse_cycle: Devices that are really one unit switching modes, such as an air conditioner controlled through template switches. When one takes over from another on a mode change, the old one isn't switched off first, so the unit changes mode without powering off.
data_description.fan_with: Adds fan modes to the thermostat. Auto runs the fan whenever these devices run, On runs it all the time, and Off leaves it alone. Fan only mode isn't affected.
data_description.fan_off_delay: In Auto, how long the fan keeps running after the device stops, for example to blow out the remaining heat.

data_description.cold_tolerance: How far below the target the temperature must drop before heating starts, and before cooling stops. With a target of 22 and 0.5, heating starts at 21.5.
data_description.hot_tolerance: How far above the target the temperature must rise before cooling starts, and before heating stops. With a target of 22 and 0.5, heating stops at 22.5.
data_description.target_temp: Used until you set a target on the thermostat.
data_description.target_temp_low: Heat/cool range used until you set one on the thermostat.
data_description.target_temp_high: Heat/cool range used until you set one on the thermostat.
data_description.min_temp: Lowest target you can set. Defaults to 7 °C (45 °F).
data_description.max_temp: Highest target you can set. Defaults to 35 °C (95 °F).
data_description.min_cycle_duration: Once a device switches on or off, how long it stays that way before switching again. Protects compressors.
data_description.max_cycle_duration: Stop a device once it has run this long, even if it's still needed. It starts again when needed, after the rest time.
data_description.cycle_cooldown: After a device stops, how long it rests before starting again. Changing the mode, target or preset skips the rest.
data_description.keep_alive: Repeat the current on/off command this often, for devices that can lose state, such as IR or RF.
data_description.initial_hvac_mode: The mode to start in the very first time. After that, the last mode is restored.
data_description.target_temp_step: Step for changing the target. Defaults to the precision.

device_tolerances.name: Separate heater and cooler tolerances
device_tolerances.description: Override the tolerances above for one device. Empty fields use them.

data_description.heater_cold_tolerance: Heating starts this far below its target.
data_description.heater_hot_tolerance: Heating stops this far above its target. With 0 it stops right at the target.
data_description.cooler_cold_tolerance: Cooling stops this far below its target. With 0 it stops right at the target.
data_description.cooler_hot_tolerance: Cooling starts this far above its target.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Each preset you give a temperature is offered on the thermostat. Leaving a preset returns to the targets from before.

data_description.away_temp: Target while the Away preset is on.
data_description.away_temp_heater: Replaces the temperature in Heat mode, and sets the low end of the range in Heat/cool.
data_description.away_temp_cooler: Replaces the temperature in Cool mode, and sets the high end of the range in Heat/cool.

data_description.comfort_temp: Target while the Comfort preset is on.
data_description.comfort_temp_heater: Replaces the temperature in Heat mode, and sets the low end of the range in Heat/cool.
data_description.comfort_temp_cooler: Replaces the temperature in Cool mode, and sets the high end of the range in Heat/cool.

data_description.eco_temp: Target while the Eco preset is on.
data_description.eco_temp_heater: Replaces the temperature in Heat mode, and sets the low end of the range in Heat/cool.
data_description.eco_temp_cooler: Replaces the temperature in Cool mode, and sets the high end of the range in Heat/cool.

data_description.home_temp: Target while the Home preset is on.
data_description.home_temp_heater: Replaces the temperature in Heat mode, and sets the low end of the range in Heat/cool.
data_description.home_temp_cooler: Replaces the temperature in Cool mode, and sets the high end of the range in Heat/cool.

data_description.sleep_temp: Target while the Sleep preset is on.
data_description.sleep_temp_heater: Replaces the temperature in Heat mode, and sets the low end of the range in Heat/cool.
data_description.sleep_temp_cooler: Replaces the temperature in Cool mode, and sets the high end of the range in Heat/cool.

data_description.activity_temp: Target while the Activity preset is on.
data_description.activity_temp_heater: Replaces the temperature in Heat mode, and sets the low end of the range in Heat/cool.
data_description.activity_temp_cooler: Replaces the temperature in Cool mode, and sets the high end of the range in Heat/cool.

interlocks.title: Interlocks
interlocks.description: Conditions that keep the devices off. The mode is kept, and control resumes once they clear.

data_description.consent_entity: While this entity isn't on (for example a calendar, schedule or input boolean), every device is kept off.
data_description.tamper_entity: While this entity is on (for example a window sensor), every device is kept off. Unlike consent, unavailable doesn't block.

water_guard.name: Water temperature guard
water_guard.description: For hydronic systems. Heating waits until the supply water is hot enough, and cooling until it's cold enough. A running device stops as soon as the water isn't.

data.water_setpoint_heat_entity: Water temperature for heating, from an entity
data.water_setpoint_cool_entity: Water temperature for cooling, from an entity

data_description.water_sensor: The supply water temperature. Without a reading, nothing is held back.
data_description.water_setpoint_heat: Heating runs only while the water is at least this, minus the tolerance.
data_description.water_setpoint_heat_entity: Takes priority over the fixed value.
data_description.water_setpoint_cool: Cooling runs only while the water is at most this, plus the tolerance.
data_description.water_setpoint_cool_entity: Takes priority over the fixed value.

error.no_devices: Choose at least one device: a heater, cooler, fan or dryer.
error.min_max_temp: The minimum target temperature must be below the maximum.
error.target_range: The low target must not be above the high target.
error.zero_duration: Durations must be longer than zero.
error.max_below_min: The maximum run time must be longer than the minimum run time.
error.fan_with_reverse_cycle: A reverse-cycle fan is the same unit as the heater or cooler, so it can't run alongside them.
error.water_needs_sensor: Choose a water temperature sensor for the water guard.
